Here they are the creative beating heart that — along with an agile, captivating lead performance from actor Taha Mandviwala — transcends the stodgy dialogue in speechifying pronouncements about life’s big questions.
Life of Pi’s animals, beautifully realized in the production, work with its human characters to illustrate vividly how a story can be constructed that is worthy of such a choice.

cn.t: Critics praise the spectacular puppetry and visual stagecraft as the stars of this theatrical adaptation, with the tiger puppet earning particular acclaim. While the technical wizardry dazzles, some find the storytelling takes a backseat to the spectacle.
